verdict.what_happens: The door swings from 80° open to its 0° shut stop at 1.48 s. After a tiny overshoot, it settles shut by 1.75 s and stays still through the end of the 6 s run.

usage.text:
The door starts open at 80° and swings shut under its hinge spring. It reaches the 0° stop at 1.48 s, briefly overshoots by about 0.1°, then settles shut by 1.75 s and remains still through 6 s. The world does what the brief says.
